Number of times inventory is sold and replenished during the year.
Cost of goods sold or shipped value / average inventory value

Orders dispatched within SLA / total dispatch-eligible orders

Share of shipments returned before successful customer delivery.

Average customer satisfaction rating collected after delivery or support interaction.

CSAT surveys, support platform and order records

Average(first response timestamp - ticket creation timestamp)
